quotes.confounding: Among the historical controls, manual matching for age, sex, ISS, head AIS, prehospital HR and SBP were used to identify the control group for the analysis... On-admission, the pulse rate, SI and serum lactate levels were significantly greater in the control group.
quotes.selection: We conducted a retrospective study... Patients who met the CRASH-2 criteria and received blood transfusion within the first 4 h but did not receive TXA during the study period were included as controls. Study exclusion criteria were patients <16 and >80 years of age, vulnerable population...
quotes.classification: All patients receiving 1 g of intravenous TXA prior to hospital admission... administered only by CCP staff.
quotes.deviations: The same protocol is also used for all trauma admissions to the emergency department (ED), and it is considered “standard of care” for the EMS team.
quotes.missingData: Data were extracted from the Qatar National Trauma Registry, which is a mature database in existence since 2007
quotes.measurement: Diagnosis of VTE included clinical, Doppler ultrasound, echocardiogram and CT pulmonary angiography tools.
quotes.reporting: All relevant predefined outcomes including MTP, VTE, mortality, and blood transfusion amounts were reported.
